ranks: The 2022 Starter Commander Decks (SCD) leftovers: 38 cards, 4 authored

blocked.name: Sarkhan, the Dragonspeaker
blocked.why: +1 makes the planeswalker a 4/4 Dragon creature (not modeled, AUTHORING §15), and the -6 emblem carries two triggered abilities; emblems hold only statics.

blocked.name: Foe-Razer Regent
blocked.why: 'Whenever a creature you control fights' — no trigger on a fight; no TriggerSpec matches the fight effect.

blocked.name: Loaming Shaman
blocked.why: 'Target player shuffles any number of target cards from their graveyard into their library': no shuffle-cards-into-library effect, and no any-number card-in-graveyard group tied to the targeted player's graveyard.

blocked.name: Curse of Bounty
blocked.why: Enchant player (an Aura attached to a player), 'whenever enchanted player is attacked' and 'each opponent attacking that player' — none modeled.

blocked.name: Curse of Disturbance
blocked.why: Enchant player and 'whenever enchanted player is attacked, … each opponent attacking that player does the same' — none modeled.

blocked.name: Gideon Jura
blocked.why: 0: becomes a 6/6 creature that's still a planeswalker (not modeled); +2: target opponent's creatures attack Gideon if able during their next turn.

blocked.name: Diluvian Primordial
blocked.why: 'For each opponent, … up to one target instant or sorcery card from that player's graveyard' — no per-opponent target slots — then casting each free, exiled after.

blocked.name: Moorland Haunt
blocked.why: 'Exile a creature card from your graveyard' as an activation cost — AbilityCost has no graveyard-exile part.

blocked.name: Jubilant Skybonder
blocked.why: Grants fliers 'spells your opponents cast that target this creature cost {2} more': targetedBySpellsCost is payLife only and only on its own permanent.

blocked.name: Liliana, Untouched by Death
blocked.why: -3: 'You may cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn' — no turn-scoped graveyard-cast permission for a player (player-effect has none; grant-graveyard-cast is one card).

blocked.name: Necromantic Selection
blocked.why: Return one of the creature cards put into any graveyard this way, under your control, as a black Zombie — return-from-graveyard reaches only your own graveyard. (exileOnResolve has since landed.)

blocked.name: Scourge of Nel Toth
blocked.why: Cast from your graveyard by paying {B}{B} and sacrificing two creatures rather than its mana cost — no graveyard alternative cost with a sacrifice.

blocked.name: Havengul Lich
blocked.why: Cast target creature card in any graveyard this turn, then gain all its activated abilities until end of turn.

blocked.name: Grimoire of the Dead
blocked.why: 'Put all creature cards from all graveyards onto the battlefield under your control. They're black Zombies' — return-from-graveyard reaches only your graveyard and can't add a colour.

blocked.name: Dredge the Mire
blocked.why: 'Each opponent chooses a creature card in their graveyard' — no choice of a graveyard card made by another player.

blocked.name: Ob Nixilis Reignited
blocked.why: -8: target opponent gets an emblem with 'Whenever a player draws a card, you lose 2 life' — emblems hold only statics, and only the effect controller's.

blocked.name: Profane Command
blocked.why: 'Up to X target creatures gain fear' (a target count of X in a castModal mode) and 'creature card with mana value X or less' in a spell's target filter (AUTHORING §6: a spell's target filter can't read X).

blocked.name: Scythe Specter
blocked.why: Each player who discarded a card with the greatest mana value among cards discarded this way loses life equal to it.

blocked.name: Sepulchral Primordial
blocked.why: 'For each opponent, … up to one target creature card from that player's graveyard' — no per-opponent target slots.

blocked.name: Soul Shatter
blocked.why: Each opponent sacrifices one with the greatest mana value among their own creatures and planeswalkers — a per-player maximum a sacrifice filter can't bind.

blocked.name: Combustible Gearhulk
blocked.why: Target opponent chooses between you drawing three and you milling three, then damage equal to the milled cards' total mana value.

blocked.name: Fiery Confluence
blocked.why: 'Choose three. You may choose the same mode more than once.'

blocked.name: Sunbird's Invocation
blocked.why: cast-now's { libraryTop } is a fixed number, looked at privately; this reveals the top X, X the triggering spell's mana value.

blocked.name: Wild Ricochet
blocked.why: 'You may choose new targets for target instant or sorcery spell' — no change-targets effect (copy-spell's newTargets is for the copy only).

blocked.name: Wildfire Devils
blocked.why: Choose a player at random; that player exiles an instant or sorcery card from their graveyard; copy that card and cast the copy free.

blocked.name: Coveted Jewel
blocked.why: 'Whenever one or more creatures an opponent controls attack you and aren't blocked, that player draws three cards and gains control of this artifact. Untap it.'

blocked.name: Explosion of Riches
blocked.why: 'Whenever a card is drawn this way', 5 damage to an opponent chosen at random.

blocked.name: Molten Slagheap
blocked.why: '{1}, Remove X storage counters from this land: Add X mana in any combination of {B} and/or {R}' — removeCounter.count is a fixed number.
